alt: 孩子抱著雙臂昂起下巴，傲慢地轉開目光，對同學認真展示的風車與滾珠模型都不屑一顧。
scene_prompt: 目空一切 means being arrogantly disdainful of everyone and everything. Modern school science fair classroom. A boastful older child stands center foreground with chin raised, arms folded naturally, eyes half-closed looking down their nose, turning away dismissively from two classmates who offer genuinely thoughtful well-made science models. One classmate holds a neatly made small windmill model, another stands beside a working simple marble ramp; both look disappointed by the arrogant child's disregard. The arrogant child's own modest model on the center desk is unimpressive, but they act as if nobody else's achievement matters. Focus on disdain toward all peers, not healthy satisfaction or confidence. Exactly three children, no crowns or pedestals, no thought bubbles, no text on posters or models; background shelves simple and unlabelled. Natural anatomy with folded arms clearly attached, hands not duplicated, stable models and grounded desks. Delicate pencil, soft watercolor, paper texture.
